name: Augustus
clue: He was beside a fire.
clue_zh: 他身旁有一堆篝火。

name: Bart
clue: He was on a hammock. There was no sack anywhere in his column.
clue_zh: 他躺在一张吊床上。他所在的那一列里没有任何麻袋。

name: Cedric
clue: Someone exactly eight rows north of him was beside the tombstone.
clue_zh: 在他正北方恰好八行的位置，有人紧挨着墓碑。

name: Dudley
clue: He was east of Griselda and west of Linus.
clue_zh: 他在 Griselda 的东边、Linus 的西边。

name: Eiko
clue: She was beside a shelf.
clue_zh: 她身旁有一个架子。

name: Fleur
clue: She was beside some flowers.
clue_zh: 她身旁有一些花。

name: Griselda
clue: She was in the top row of her area.
clue_zh: 她在自己所在区域的最上面一排。

name: Hyacinth
clue: She was on the Cliff. No one in an adjacent column wore a hat.
clue_zh: 她在悬崖（Cliff）上。相邻的那一列里没有人戴帽子。

name: Isolde
clue: She was siting in a chair. She was in a Cabin with someone wearing an eyepatch.
clue_zh: 她坐在一把椅子上。她和一个戴眼罩的人在同一间小屋（Cabin）里。

name: Julius
clue: He was beside a barrel.
clue_zh: 他身旁有一个木桶。

name: Kathleen
clue: She was on a Sloop.
clue_zh: 她在一艘单桅帆船（Sloop）上。

name: Linus
clue: He was beside a tree.
clue_zh: 他身旁有一棵树。

name: Mortimer
clue: He was on a ship, beside some rope.
clue_zh: 他在一艘船上，旁边有一些绳子。

name: Nehemiah
clue: He was in the Water, beside a ship.
clue_zh: 他在水域（Water）里，旁边有一艘船。

name: Orville
clue: He was on a ship.
clue_zh: 他在一艘船上。

name: Pedro
clue: He was on a bed.
clue_zh: 他在一张床上。

name: Quincy
clue: He was in the Water, beside a shark.
clue_zh: 他在水域里，旁边有一条鲨鱼。

name: Rosalind
clue: She was siting in a chair.
clue_zh: 她坐在一把椅子上。

name: Seraphina
clue: She was at least six rows north of Linus.
clue_zh: 她在 Linus 正北方至少六行的位置。

name: Ursula
clue: She was in front of a door.
clue_zh: 她在一扇门前面。

name: Wilfred
clue: He was beside a pig.
clue_zh: 他身旁有一头猪。

name: Yannis
clue: He was in the Woods. He was not beside a tree.
clue_zh: 他在树林（Woods）里。他不在树旁边。

name: Zoe
clue: She was beside a shrub.
clue_zh: 她身旁有一丛灌木。

name: Treasure
clue: In the last square. It can be buried beneath an object that cannot otherwise be occupied.
clue_zh: 在最后一格。它可以被埋在一个本来无法被占用的物件下面。
